evidence.C1: Journal and Care screens successfully implement the 'field-guide look' with numbered plates and ledger lines, but the Garden inventory list reverts to dense text.
evidence.C2: Tooltips like 'Tap a fish to meet it' guide new users well, though the Fishing screen relies on a text-heavy sidebar to explain complex gesture controls.
evidence.C3: Feature summary includes every loop required for a top score: 'breeding, scaping, greenhouse, reef genetics, orders, journal, focus'.
evidence.C4: Floating cards and layered shadows are consistent in Tank and Care views, but the Garden screen's inventory list breaks this visual pattern with plain text links.

fixes: Redesign the Garden 'Inventory' list to use visual cards or icons instead of dense text links, maintaining the 'field guide' aesthetic established in the Journal and Tank screens.
Simplify the Fishing tutorial by adding interactive overlays for the 'flick' and 'crank' mechanics, reducing reliance on the dense text explanation in the Controls panel.
Promote critical maintenance actions (e.g., 'Change 40% of water') to the top of the Care screen when water quality is low, rather than burying them below the test results.

evidence.C1: Distinctive field-guide aesthetic with 'No. 01' plates, dotted ledger lines, and warm cream palette; tank drawn as glass box with perspective, depth haze, and shadows. However, the tank fish themselves read as fairly simple vector shapes compared to the richly detailed environment.
evidence.C2: 'How to do' section on Tank screen explicitly lists next steps (Go fishing, Greenhouse and reef lab, Field journal); tools row and bottom nav are clearly grouped and labelled; phone views are not cramped. Some screens (Care, Garden) pack dense information that could use stronger hierarchy.
evidence.C3: Multiple interlocking loops explicitly listed: care (nitrogen cycle), fishing minigame (9 spots, flick+reel, tournaments, 47 species), breeding with inherited colours, aquascaping (16 plants, 8 hardscape, 3 substrates), greenhouse (cuttings, variegated sports), reef lab (frag, cross, named strains), orders, journal (18 milestones), focus timer, plus koi pond. Clearly exceeds a typical cozy aquarium app.
evidence.C4: Consistent pill buttons, floating white cards with layered shadows, uniform typography and spacing across Tank/Care/Fishing/Garden/Journal/Focus/Pond. Selected nav states are clear. Minor rough edges: koi pond fish look stylistically inconsistent with tank fish, and some tile grids (Care water test) feel uniform rather than designed.

fixes: Increase detail/dimensionality of the tank fish so they match the richness of the environment (shading, scale texture, fin articulation) rather than reading as flat vector silhouettes.
Reconcile the koi pond fish style with the tank fish style — the koi look more cartoonish/illustrated than the tank residents, breaking visual consistency across the app.
Improve visual hierarchy on dense screens (Care water test grid, Garden inventory, Fishing side column) so primary actions and warnings stand out from secondary readings.

evidence.C1: Coherent cream/green palette with serif/sans pairing; tank drawn as a 'glass box (perspective side panes, receding gravel floor, depth haze)'; journal uses field-guide plates ('No. 01', 'Try Lily pond · fresh', silhouettes). Not a 10: the Garden screen is a dense wall of equal cards and the fishing sun/sky are flat fills, so not every screen feels fully designed.
evidence.C2: Next step is spelled out everywhere: 'Tap a fish to meet it, or tap the glass.', 'Flick up on the water, or press Cast', 'Pick a length and start when you are ready.', 'More to do' arrow links, journal hints 'Try Lily pond · fresh'. Controls grouped and labelled (tools row, Flick/Classic toggle, quiet pond row). Held at 9 because shop/residents/reef screens aren't visible to confirm the same standard.
evidence.C3: All anchor loops present and interlocking: 'nitrogen cycle simulation', reel/tension fishing minigame with '47 species, 5 rarities', 'Breeding with inherited colours', scaping, 'Greenhouse trays (cuttings, harvest, variegated sports)', 'reef lab (frag, cross, named strains)', daily orders, journal/milestones, focus timer earning shells; 'trimming into cuttings' and 'arrow links to the next step of each loop' tie them together.
evidence.C4: Consistent pills, cards, nav and selection states across all eight screenshots; water-test tiles share one pattern with 'fine' status dots; pond controls 'fade after 10 s idle'. Not pixel-perfect: the 'Filter bacteria' tile sits alone in the Care grid, and on mobile-tank the bottom nav shows both Tank and Focus highlighted with the same treatment.

fixes: Tighten the Garden screen's visual hierarchy - trays, how-it-works steps, seed shelf, orders and inventory read as a wall of same-sized cards; give sections clearer dominance so it matches the crafted feel of the other screens.

Make the tank more clearly the hero at 1440 px: enlarge the tank relative to the side column and lighten the text-heavy 'More to do'/status cards so the desktop tank screen matches the mobile one's impact.

Mop up small polish items: rebalance the Care water-test grid so 'Filter bacteria' doesn't sit alone, enrich flat scenery fills (sun disc, sky) in the fishing scene, and give a running Focus session a nav highlight visually distinct from the active tab.
